section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Self-Attributed Need for Uniqueness Scale (Lynn & Harris, 1997) as a 4-item, 5-point fill-in-the-blank measure used to assess desire for uniqueness, noting it has been used in body image research. It reports that items were averaged and that internal consistency in the current study was adequate (women ˛= .75, men ˛= .73). The section does not provide study-level details such as sample size, country, recruitment source, BMI, age, or correlations with body appreciation.
